title: Calculating the Returnless Damage Credit on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
**Payments & Refunds desk statement.**

The returnless damage credit on a Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders purchase is the damaged units multiplied by the damaged-unit value, plus the severity credit, the late-arrival credit, the multi-issue credit and the subscriber credit, added together and rounded half up to the cent once at the end. Where that sum is above the method's largest returnless refund, no returnless damage credit is given and the item comes back under a return authorization. The price paid per unit is the amount billed on the order's line charges divided by the units charged on them, rounded half up to the cent. The damaged-unit value is the price paid per unit, and the severity credit, the late-arrival credit, the multi-issue credit and the subscriber credit are each nothing.

## Inputs

| Input | Record |
|---|---|
| Damaged units | The units on the damage report being settled |
| Amount billed on the line charges | Total amount billed on the order's line charges |
| Units charged | Total units on the order's line charges |
| Price paid per unit | Amount billed divided by units charged, rounded half up to the cent |
| Largest returnless refund | The figure for the order's fulfillment method in the method's damage and missing-item terms |

## Comparison and rounding

The sum is compared with the method's largest returnless refund before it is rounded; a sum equal to that figure is not above it. When the sum is not above it, the credit is the sum rounded half up to the cent; when it is above it, the credit is nothing and the item comes back under a return authorization.

## Worked examples (hypothetical orders, hypothetical $25.00 limit)

| Line charges | Damaged units | Price paid per unit | Sum | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 units billed $44.97 | 1 | $14.99 | $14.99 | $14.99 |
| 3 units billed $44.97 | 2 | $14.99 | $29.98 | Nothing - the item comes back under a return authorization |
| 4 units billed $50.00 | 2 | $12.50 | $25.00 | $25.00 (equal to the limit, not above it) |
